title: Fasting Insulin
subtitle: What fasting insulin measures, how to interpret it, limitations, and when it is clinically useful.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from clinical endocrinology and laboratory science underpins fasting insulin testing utility in metabolic health assessment. Emerging research supports its use combined with other indices for improved diabetes risk prediction. Some assay variability and lack of universal cut-offs limit its standalone diagnostic ability, establishing the need for contextual interpretation.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
